title: Senior Android Developer
text:
Demo Co. Alder is a scale-up building media apps. We are looking for a senior-level Android Developer to join our mobile team. Work is on-site in our Oldmoor office.

Our stack: java. You will improve app performance and stability, own the release process and review code with the team.

Modern devices for testing. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.

The role includes a 24/7 on-call rotation.
